name: 二手玫瑰
hint: 一朵被转赠的浪漫。
scene: At an old Chinese flea market, two weathered hands pass one slightly wilted red rose between them above a scratched wooden counter. Quiet documentary closeup, rose in lower third, blurred empty market behind, soft dawn side light, muted earthy colors, analog grain. No price signs.

name: 橘子海
hint: 海面留下了另一种日落。
scene: A single vivid orange fruit floats in an immense still pale blue sea, distant horizon very high, subtle rings of ripples, overcast silver light. Minimalist large-format seascape, fruit tiny but recognizable in lower third, nuanced cyan and orange, extremely quiet.

name: 新裤子
hint: 还没留下生活的褶皱。
scene: A pristine pair of indigo jeans hangs from a thin clothesline across a bare warm white courtyard wall. Crisp sunlight casts a sculptural long shadow; no person, no other laundry, minimalist fashion editorial, deep indigo, bone white, fine natural texture.

name: 刺猬
hint: 柔软的夜里，有一身尖刺。
scene: A real small hedgehog on a vast dark wet rural road at night, illuminated by a soft narrow beam from outside frame, its fine spines rim-lit, low viewpoint, deep black-and-white documentary wildlife photograph, a small vulnerable creature in immense negative space.

name: 痛仰
hint: 向上，也是一种抵抗。
scene: Black and white humanist street photograph: a lone adult man in a rain-soaked empty courtyard, head tilted back toward rain, eyes closed, taut neck and exhausted expression, hands loose at sides. Strong overhead shaft of diffused light, dignified restrained emotional intensity, environmental portrait, no injury.

name: 万能青年旅店
hint: 有人在这里短暂停靠。
scene: A modest old youth hostel at blue hour in a Chinese industrial town, one warmly lit upstairs window with a young traveler silhouette, worn facade, a bicycle and backpack by entrance, narrow building centered amid empty street, cinematic yet truthful architectural documentary, no signs or letters.

name: 五条人
hint: 数一数，走过的人。
scene: Exactly five distant adults walking separately along a broad concrete sea wall, photographed from a high oblique angle, their five long shadows form a rhythm across pale surface. Black-and-white coastal humanist photography, sparse composition, natural hard afternoon light. Exactly five people, no others.

name: 海龟先生
hint: 一位不着急赴约的绅士。
scene: A lifelike sea turtle swims elegantly through dark teal sea water, wearing only a tiny believable black bow tie at its neck. Underwater fine art wildlife photograph, turtle side-profile in lower half, a single soft column of sunlight, realistic shell, suspended particles, subtly surreal and dignified.

name: 木马
hint: 童年在空房间里轻轻摇晃。
scene: One antique wooden rocking horse in a cavernous abandoned apartment room, peeling pale walls, dusty floor, a narrow warm window beam lights the wooden mane and worn saddle. Large-format quiet still life, asymmetric composition, muted umber and cool gray, deep shadows.

name: 黑豹
hint: 黑暗也有自己的轮廓。
scene: A real black panther almost disappearing into deep black forest shadows, only amber eyes and soft rim light revealing its black fur profile. Fine art wildlife portrait, face placed in bottom third, dark negative space above, subtle texture, restrained and powerful, no fantasy eyes.

name: 唐朝
hint: 风把一个朝代吹进了今天。
scene: An empty ancient Chinese Tang-style palace courtyard in morning mist, a single historical court dancer seen very small from behind in muted rust-red silk robe, long sleeves stirred by wind, monumental wooden pillars frame the scene, elegant architectural photography, no fantasy, soft pearl light.

name: 逃跑计划
hint: 窗外有一条尚未走过的路。
scene: A modest dark bedroom at dawn, open window reveals pale sky, a bedsheet rope tied securely to the bedpost leads through the window, small packed suitcase on floor. Carefully staged cinematic photographic still life, oblique composition, cool dawn and tiny warm bedside light, no people, no text.

name: 落日飞车
genre: 迷幻流行 / 独立摇滚
hint: 在最后一束光里离开地面。
scene: A weathered vintage cream coupe suspended just a meter above an empty coastal road, low orange sunset exactly behind it, car wheels airborne, physically convincing light and shadow, wide surroundings framed vertically, subdued film colors, a poetic surreal automotive editorial photograph, no driver visible.

name: 草东没有派对
hint: 音乐停了，草还在长。
scene: An abandoned outdoor gathering in an overgrown grass field at early dawn: an empty folding table, two fallen paper cups, one deflated balloon caught in grass, no people. Eastern horizon washed with faint sunrise, quiet environmental documentary photograph, vast breathing room, restrained muted olive and mist.

name: 茄子蛋
hint: 厨房里的一场意外相遇。
scene: One deep purple eggplant and one white hen egg resting together on a dark worn kitchen table. Single soft window side light, sculptural organic shapes, deep violet black and luminous ivory, museum-quality restrained still-life photograph, generous dark negative space, no other food.

name: 椅子乐团
genre: 独立流行 / 迷幻摇滚
hint: 空着的位置，也能合奏。
scene: Three mismatched wooden chairs stand in a loosely rhythmic arc on a bare empty theater stage. A shaft of dusty side light brushes their seats. Quiet black-and-white large-format interior photograph, striking geometric negative space, no musical instruments or people.

name: 告五人
hint: 一封尚未被读出的告白。
scene: Exactly five adults stand far apart on the broad steps of a brutalist civic building, one foreground hand holds an open folded blank letter aimed toward them, shallow but sufficiently legible depth, restrained humanist documentary in black and white, graphic architecture, no printed words, no additional people.

name: 旅行团
hint: 把远方装进同一趟出发。
scene: A small group of six travelers carrying worn suitcases waits at a deserted rural bus stop in western China, backs toward camera, misty mountain distance, no bus. Editorial humanist travel photograph, individuals placed as careful rhythm along bottom third, faded sage and warm gray, morning light, blank stop sign.

name: 声音玩具
hint: 童年的声音，有了形状。
scene: An old colorful tin toy robot and a small wind-up music box on an empty worn wooden floor, golden window light, the tiny mechanism and patina visible, quiet nostalgic still-life photograph, muted colors with one scarlet detail, ample empty wall, shallow selective focus, no labels.

name: 盘尼西林
hint: 小小一瓶，装着某种解药。
scene: One unlabeled vintage amber glass antibiotic vial beside a carefully placed old metal syringe on a white linen surface in a quiet empty clinic. Clean natural window light, pale cyan shadows, intimate clinical still life, fine glass reflections, high aesthetic restraint, no lettering, no person.

name: 九连真人
hint: 九个身影，站成一条真实的线。
scene: Exactly nine real adults in everyday plain clothing stand in one long horizontal line across an empty village basketball court, photographed from elevated angle, big blank concrete foreground, hazy hills, overcast light, monumental yet intimate humanist documentary photograph, no extra people.

name: 回春丹
hint: 旧物里，长出一个春天。
scene: A single round dark red traditional herbal pill on a worn porcelain saucer, from a crack beside it sprouts a tiny fresh green shoot, on aged wooden apothecary table. Fine-art macro still life with large surrounding negative space, soft early spring side light, warm brown and fresh green, no writing.

name: 霓虹花园
hint: 夜色开出的花。
scene: A small overgrown garden at night with real flowering shrubs, wet leaves catch magenta and cyan neon reflected from a city outside frame; no visible letters or neon signs. Poetic night landscape photography, one quiet winding path, rich dark blacks, restrained pools of electric color, subtle film grain.

name: 丢火车
hint: 铁轨还在，列车不见了。
scene: Empty railway tracks end abruptly at the edge of an immense fogbound open plain, a tiny abandoned red toy locomotive sits beside the rail in foreground. Melancholic large format fine-art landscape photography, very high foggy horizon, desaturated steel tones, subtle rust red, no people.

name: 白皮书
hint: 一整本，还没被说出口的话。
scene: One thick entirely blank white hardcover book lies open on an empty white plaster plinth, all pages pure white with no letters, sculptural daylight grazes the fanned page edges, white on white fine-art still-life photography, deep subtle shadow gradients, architectural composition.

name: 超级市场
hint: 当喧闹撤离货架之后。
scene: A deserted old supermarket aisle late at night, rows of plain unbranded packages, one lonely shopping cart at far end, overhead fluorescent strip reflected on polished floor. Strict one-point perspective, fine-art architectural photograph, faded mint and cream, haunting but elegant, no readable text.

name: 鸭打鹅
hint: 池塘边的一次小小冲突。
scene: A real duck flaps a wing toward a startled white goose in the shallows of a quiet pond, a precisely frozen splash arcs between them, intimate wildlife documentary shot with long lens, soft gray water and pale reflected sky, minimal background, dynamic decisive moment, no harm.

name: 太极
hint: 一半明，一半暗。
scene: Top-down fine-art photograph of two koi, one white and one black, swimming in a circular yin-yang formation in a dark round pond, natural soft skylight, very minimal near-monochrome palette, real water ripples and elegant fluid negative space, no drawn yin yang icon.

name: 面孔
hint: 在人群消失后，记住一个人。
scene: A deeply human black-and-white close-up portrait of an older anonymous Chinese craftsman, weathered face and direct quiet gaze, dark plain background, one soft window light, large-format skin detail, strong asymmetric framing, dignity, no dramatic makeup, no text.

name: 指南针
hint: 迷路的时候，仍然有一个方向。
scene: A single worn brass compass resting on a vast pale sand dune, fine delicate windblown ripples, distant cool mountains at upper edge. Carefully framed large-format still-life landscape, warm low sunrise grazing sand, small compass in lower third, precise metallic texture, no readable brand text.
